lead: Plan a trip to Mars or the Moon in a giant Starship. A fleet of tanker rockets fills it up in orbit around Earth, and on Mars it makes its own fuel to fly home.
try: In the Mission planner, keep Mars picked and press Fly this plan. Then click Moon, or drag the Trip time slider, and watch how many tanker flights you need.
points: The ship cannot lift enough fuel from the ground, so tanker rockets fly up one after another to fill it in space. Smaller tankers mean more trips.
Rushing costs a lot. On the fastest trip the ship hits Mars too fast for its heat shield, so it must burn extra fuel to slow down and needs many times more fuel.
Landing on the Moon takes more rocket power than landing on Mars. Mars has air that does most of the braking, but the Moon has none, so every slowdown is a rocket burn.
